thread:
alex: Heads-up — Ember Medical sent an RFI asking for a staged POC (onprem option + VPC), pricing bands, and an answer about HSM/KMS integration. They want attachments and a capability matrix by EOD tomorrow.

mike: @alex can you drop the exact security questionnaire items they flagged? any deal size estimate?

alex: They attached a 40-question security sheet focusing on: data residency, key management, audit logs retention, SOC/ISO reports, and network peering. Deal is mid-enterprise, likely starts with a 3-month POC ~$25k expected. Link to their packet: https://drive.google.com/example/ember-rfi.pdf

mike: Cool. For the POC ops plan I suggest 2 stages: 1) Hosted sandbox on Redwood API with synthetic data to validate latency/cost. 2) Private VPC deploy for integration with their KMS and audit log ingestion. I can draft runbook.

tara: @mike +1. For KMS/HSM questions we should say: we support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSM-backed key material via our Private deployment connectors. Need to surface SLA for key rotation and a note about no plaintext key export from HSM.

jen: Also call out network peering options and egress controls — Ember needs FIPS endpoints. We have a checklist. I can attach the checklist and the HSM integration diagram.

alex: Perfect. Can one of you put together a capability matrix row for: model hosting modes, data residency, KMS/HSM support, audit logs retention, SLA, and typical latency figures (p50/p95) for 4k tokens? Keep it short, one-liners.

mike: I'll do the technical rows. Quick draft pricing to include in RFI (we can refine):
```
POC Tier A — Hosted eval: $8,000/month (up to 10M prompt tokens), 30-day support
POC Tier B — Dedicated reserve (3 mo): $24,000 total (reserved capacity + support)
POC Tier C — Private deploy (on-prem/VPC): $45,000 setup + $12,000/month ops
```
Add note: enterprise discounts and SOW for integrations.

tara: For the security answers: include cert matrix (SOC2 Type II — in progress, ISO27001 available), MFA + SSO support, audit log retention options (30/90/365 days), and encryption at rest/in transit. Also clarify we can integrate with HSM vendors but full FIPS validation may require customer coordination.

alex: Can someone attach the capability matrix + the HSM diagram and the pricing table to the RFI response doc? They specifically asked for attachments.

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/ember/poceval-v1.pdf (uploader: mike) :white_check_mark:

jen: I uploaded the HSM integration diagram and the network checklist to the same folder. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/ember/hsm-network.zip

mike: Draft RFI text snippet (put this in the response doc):
"Redwood Inference supports staged POCs to de-risk integrations. We recommend starting with a hosted evaluation to validate latency and models, followed by a private VPC deployment to connect to customer-managed KMS/HSM. Our Private deployment provides audit logs, configurable retention, and support for common HSM connectors. Pricing is flexible and we offer reserved capacity for predictable throughput."

alex: Great. @tara can you answer question 12 (key rotation cadence + proof) and question 28 (log integrity)? They asked for exact language.

tara: Q12: Key rotation cadence is customer-controlled in their KMS; Redwood recommends rotation every 90 days for sensitive data and we support automated rewraps without downtime. Q28: Audit logs are write-once, stored in the customer's VPC (for Private) or in our managed logs with tamper-evident hashes; we can provide periodic attestations on request.

alex: This is shaping up. Last ask from Ember — can we include estimated p50/p95 latency numbers for their expected throughput (100 reqs/s, avg 512 tokens)?

mike: Baseline: Hosted API p50 ~ 60ms/token, p95 ~ 220ms/token for 512 tokens with our 8-GPU prod cluster. For Dedicated reserve we can guarantee 20% lower p95 under committed throughput. I'll add a short table in the response.

alex: Awesome. I'll compile everything and send the RFI package to Ember. Everyone, please review the doc in the folder by 5pm. :thumbsup:

cs-bot: Reminder: add legal's minimal re: data processing addendum before sending.

jen: Noted — I'll ping legal for the DPA and include the SOW template.

alex: Thanks all — tagging this as high priority. If anyone finds a blocker post here.
